messages:
Samir Khan: Quick idea  run a 20-min "Late Night Demo Lane" at DevNight on Fri. Two people per shift, a demo + quick benchmark chat. QR leads to short Typeform that signs up for webinar + attaches benchmark PDF.
Leah Park: Love it. I'll own the print assets and packing checklist. Two postcard variants? numbers-first vs outcome-first A/B.
Tom Reyes: I can supply the short latency/cost numbers for the postcard. Tentative: median token lat ~88ms, p95 ~190ms on our 4k config. Cost example: ~2.1x improvement vs baseline. Will confirm exacts by Thu.
Priya Nair: I'll place swag order today. Proposal: 120 stickers (various sizes), 50 prompt-cards (laminated), 30 custom keycards with NFC (maybe overkill, ok to skip?), and a small raffle prize (postal gift card). Budget check in notes.
Jordan Lee: I'll build the Typeform and webhook routing. Plan: fields = name / email / company / interest (webinar/benchmark/dedicated). Flow: Typeform -> Segment -> Salesforce lead with tag `devnight_lane` and `benchmark_pdf`. Auto-send webinar invite 24h after signup + 3-day nurture with benchmark.
Leah Park: Good. For prints: side A = headline + quick metric; side B = CTA + QR + 15s elevator script. I'll mock two copy versions and print 60/60 to test.
Samir Khan: Staffing rota? Volunteers: Samir, Tom, Priya, Leah, Jordan. Need one extra for 79pm shift. Any volunteers?
Tom Reyes: I can do 67:30pm. Also will bring a backup MacBook + HDMI, power strip, and a tiny speaker for demo audio.
Priya Nair: Ordering note: used PrintQuick ref PQ-4492. ETA Fri morning. Cost center 4021. I'll upload invoice and tracking to the marketing drive.
Jordan Lee: Routing detail: Typeform webhooks -> /webhook/sales-incoming (curl sample in doc). Also will include a nightly CSV dump for ops. I'll add mapping table (Segment trait -> SFDC fields) to the doc.
Leah Park: Messaging test plan: track which postcard variant gets scanned. We'll put a small sticker on the back with A/B marker for tracking. Also keep a short script for booth staff: 1) quick pitch 2) ask about benchmark interest 3) scan QR 4) optional raffle entry.
Samir Khan: Speaking submissions update: we have one accepted slot for "Efficient LLM Inference at Scale"  want to prep a 12-min talk + 3-min Q&A. Leah, Tom  can you draft a 3-slide talk outline? Deadline Wed.
Tom Reyes: I'll draft slides emphasizing runtime optimizations and a micro benchmark demo. Need to pick 2 real-world examples.
Priya Nair: Swag packing: I'll prepare pre-packed envelopes per shift: 4 postcards (mix), 2 stickers, 1 prompt-card, raffle ticket. That should speed exchanges.
Jordan Lee: On-site logistics: I'll coordinate pickup with venue. Plan to collect prints Fri 4pm from PrintQuick. Venue contact = Mia (mia@venue.com), phone 555-0132. I'll confirm on Thu.
Leah Park: Timeline: Wed end-of-day  talk outline; Thu noon  final postcard PDFs; Thu 4pm  print pickup; Fri 10am  swag delivered to office; Fri 3pm  packing; Fri 6pm  load into car. Acks?
Samir Khan: Ack.
Leah Park: Ack. I'll push PDFs to Drive by 11:30am Thu.
Tom Reyes: Ack, will finish metrics sheet and demo script by EOD Thu.
Priya Nair: Ack, order placed and tracking shared.
Jordan Lee: Ack, Typeform draft live (https://typeform.com/to/abcd)  will replace with final.
ops-bot: Reminder: Print pickup scheduled Thu 16:00 at PrintQuick (PQ-4492). Courier hold enabled. :bell:
Samir Khan: Great work team. If anything blocks, drop it here. Let's keep the lane snappy and focus on collecting quality leads. :rocket:
